## out-flat/.kilo/plugin/aidd-context-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd: aidd-context/hooks/hooks.json.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-context/", import.meta.url));
const SESSION_START = [{"script":"memory.cjs","args":["load"]},{"script":"artifacts.cjs","args":["start"]}];
const STOP = [{"script":"memory.cjs","args":["sync"]}];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [{"script":"artifacts.cjs","args":["mark"],"matcher":"Write|Edit|Bash|Shell|bash|PowerShell|apply_patch"}];
const PRE_TOOL_USE = [];
const USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT = [];

function runHook(script, args, payload, directory) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
    cwd: directory,
    stdio: ["pipe", "ignore", "ignore"],
    timeout: 5000,
  });
  let reported = false;
  const report = (error) => {
    if (reported) return;
    reported = true;
    reportHookFailure(script, error);
  };
  child.on("error", report);
  child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
    if (code !== 0 || signal !== null) {
      report("exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")"));
    }
  });
  child.stdin.on("error", report);
  child.stdin.end(body);
}

// Exit 2 puts the answer on stderr; exit 0 puts it in additionalContext on stdout.
function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  if (code !== 0) return "";
  try {
    const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
    return String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/** Runs one hook script with its payload on stdin and collects what it wrote. */
function runCapture(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stdout += chunk;
    });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk;
    });
    child.on("error", () => resolve({ code: null, stdout: "", stderr: "" }));
    child.on("close", (code) => resolve({ code, stdout, stderr }));
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ code, stdout }) => {
    if (code !== 0) return "";
    try {
      const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
      return output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  });
}

/** Awaited, unlike runHook: a script that fails to run, or exits other than 0 or 2, is reported
 * and answers nothing. */
function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ code, stdout, stderr }) => {
    if (code !== 0 && code !== 2) {
      reportHookFailure(script, "exited with code " + String(code));
      return "";
    }
    return answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr);
  });
}

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function matchesTool(matcher, tool) {
  return !matcher || matcher.split("|").some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === tool.toLowerCase());
}

/** Pure: a call about to run -> every PreToolUse hook whose matcher allows its tool. The host
 * hands the arguments in the output, and names the written file `filePath`. */
function preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, directory) {
  const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
  const args = output?.args;
  const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
  return PRE_TOOL_USE.filter((hook) => matchesTool(hook.matcher, tool)).map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "PreToolUse",
      session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      tool_name: tool,
      tool_input: toolInput,
    },
  }));
}

/** The reason the first script that refuses gave, or null when none does. */
async function refusalOf(calls) {
  for (const call of calls) {
    const { code, stderr } = await runCapture(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
    if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

const FOLLOW_UP = { aidd: "stop-follow-up" };

function isFollowUp(parts) {
  return parts.some((part) => part?.metadata?.aidd === FOLLOW_UP.aidd);
}

/** Pure: the user's message -> every UserPromptSubmit hook's call, none for a follow-up. The text
 * is the user's own: a part another hook added is not. */
function userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory) {
  const parts = output?.parts ?? [];
  if (isFollowUp(parts)) return [];
  const prompt = parts
    .filter((part) => part?.type === "text" && !part.synthetic)
    .map((part) => part.text)
    .join("\n");
  return USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "UserPromptSubmit",
      session_id: input?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      prompt,
    },
  }));
}

/** Each answer becomes a synthetic text part after the user's, its id derived from the first
 * part's, this plugin's name and the hook's place in its list, so no two parts share one. */
async function addPromptContext(input, output, directory) {
  const calls = userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory);
  for (const [index, call] of calls.entries()) {
    const answer = await answerOf(call.script, call.args, call.payload, directory);
    if (!answer) continue;
    output.parts.push({
      id: output.parts[0].id + "-" + "aidd-context" + "-" + index,
      messageID: output.message?.id,
      sessionID: input?.sessionID,
      type: "text",
      text: answer,
      synthetic: true,
    });
  }
}

function sessionStartCallsFor(event, directory) {
  if (event?.type !== "session.created") return [];
  return SESSION_START.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: event.properties?.sessionID ?? null, cwd: event.properties?.info?.directory ?? directory },
  }));
}

const AiddContextKiloHooks = async ({ directory, client }) => {
  const sessions = new Map();
  return {
  event: async ({ event }) => {
    try {
      const properties = event?.properties;
      const id = properties?.sessionID;
      if (typeof id !== "string") return;
      if (event?.type === "session.deleted") { sessions.delete(id); return; }
      if (!sessions.has(id)) sessions.set(id, { started: false, idle: false, continued: false, directory });
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      let calls = [];
      if (event?.type === "session.created" && !session.started) {
        session.started = true;
        session.directory = properties?.info?.directory ?? directory;
        calls = sessionStartCallsFor(event, session.directory);
      } else if (event?.type === "session.status" && properties?.status?.type === "busy") {
        session.idle = false;
      } else if (event?.type === "session.idle" && !session.idle) {
        session.idle = true;
        // Limit: one Stop hook per plugin; with several, the last verdict decides the continuation.
        for (const hook of STOP) {
          const payload = { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: id, cwd: session.directory, stop_hook_active: session.continued };
          const reason = await stopReasonOf(hook.script, hook.args, payload, session.directory);
          session.continued = reason !== "";
          // Not awaited: the prompt is the session's next turn, and this handler must not hold it.
          // Kilo 7.8.27's `run` waits for the queue to drain, so the follow-up lands there too; awaiting
          // it from `dispose` fails with an UnknownError. 7.7.5 lost it in `run`.
          if (reason) {
            client.session
              .promptAsync({ path: { id }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text: reason, metadata: FOLLOW_UP }] } })
              .catch((error) => reportHookFailure(hook.script, "follow-up not delivered: " + String(error)));
          }
        }
      }
      for (const call of calls) {
        runHook(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  // A user's message starts a new turn. Kilo hands every plugin every message, so a follow-up,
  // this bridge's or another plugin's, is recognised by its mark and is not one.
  "chat.message": async (input, output) => {
    const session = sessions.get(input?.sessionID);
    if (session && !isFollowUp(output?.parts ?? [])) session.continued = false;
    try {
      await addPromptContext(input, output, session?.directory ?? directory);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  // The refusal is thrown out of the hook, the one way the host stops the call.
  "tool.execute.before": async (call, output) => {
    let refusal = null;
    try {
      refusal = await refusalOf(preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
    if (refusal !== null) throw new Error(refusal);
  },
  "tool.execute.after": async (call, output) => {
    try {
      const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
      const cwd = sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory;
      // Kilo names the written file filePath; the scripts read Claude Code's file_path.
      const args = call?.args;
      const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
      for (const hook of POST_TOOL_USE.filter((hook) => matchesTool(hook.matcher, tool))) {
        const answer = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "PostToolUse", session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null, cwd, tool_name: tool, tool_input: toolInput }, cwd);
        if (answer) output.output = `${output.output ?? ""}\n\n${answer}`;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  };
};

AiddContextKiloHooks.sessionStartCallsFor = sessionStartCallsFor;

export default { id: "aidd-context-hooks", server: AiddContextKiloHooks };


## out-flat/.kilo/plugin/aidd-telemetry-hooks.js
// Generated by aidd: aidd-telemetry/hooks/hooks.json.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HOOKS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("../hooks/aidd-telemetry/", import.meta.url));
const SESSION_START = [{"script":"task.cjs","args":["remind"]},{"script":"ledger.cjs","args":["ingest"]}];
const STOP = [];
const POST_TOOL_USE = [];
const PRE_TOOL_USE = [];
const USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT = [];

function runHook(script, args, payload, directory) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
    cwd: directory,
    stdio: ["pipe", "ignore", "ignore"],
    timeout: 5000,
  });
  let reported = false;
  const report = (error) => {
    if (reported) return;
    reported = true;
    reportHookFailure(script, error);
  };
  child.on("error", report);
  child.on("close", (code, signal) => {
    if (code !== 0 || signal !== null) {
      report("exited with code " + String(code) + (signal === null ? "" : " (" + signal + ")"));
    }
  });
  child.stdin.on("error", report);
  child.stdin.end(body);
}

// Exit 2 puts the answer on stderr; exit 0 puts it in additionalContext on stdout.
function answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr) {
  if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  if (code !== 0) return "";
  try {
    const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
    return String(output?.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext ?? output?.additionalContext ?? "").trim();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/** Runs one hook script with its payload on stdin and collects what it wrote. */
function runCapture(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = "";
    let stderr = "";
    const child = spawn("node", [HOOKS_DIR + script, ...args], {
      cwd: directory,
      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
      timeout: 5000,
    });
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stdout += chunk;
    });
    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk;
    });
    child.on("error", () => resolve({ code: null, stdout: "", stderr: "" }));
    child.on("close", (code) => resolve({ code, stdout, stderr }));
    child.stdin.on("error", () => {});
    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
  });
}

/** A Stop script's {"decision":"block","reason"} on stdout: the reason to keep working on. */
function stopReasonOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ code, stdout }) => {
    if (code !== 0) return "";
    try {
      const output = JSON.parse(stdout);
      return output?.decision === "block" ? String(output.reason ?? "").trim() : "";
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  });
}

/** Awaited, unlike runHook: a script that fails to run, or exits other than 0 or 2, is reported
 * and answers nothing. */
function answerOf(script, args, payload, directory) {
  return runCapture(script, args, payload, directory).then(({ code, stdout, stderr }) => {
    if (code !== 0 && code !== 2) {
      reportHookFailure(script, "exited with code " + String(code));
      return "";
    }
    return answerFrom(code, stdout, stderr);
  });
}

function reportHookFailure(script, error) {
  console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook " + script + " failed: " + String(error));
}

function matchesTool(matcher, tool) {
  return !matcher || matcher.split("|").some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === tool.toLowerCase());
}

/** Pure: a call about to run -> every PreToolUse hook whose matcher allows its tool. The host
 * hands the arguments in the output, and names the written file `filePath`. */
function preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, directory) {
  const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
  const args = output?.args;
  const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
  return PRE_TOOL_USE.filter((hook) => matchesTool(hook.matcher, tool)).map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "PreToolUse",
      session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      tool_name: tool,
      tool_input: toolInput,
    },
  }));
}

/** The reason the first script that refuses gave, or null when none does. */
async function refusalOf(calls) {
  for (const call of calls) {
    const { code, stderr } = await runCapture(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
    if (code === 2) return stderr.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

const FOLLOW_UP = { aidd: "stop-follow-up" };

function isFollowUp(parts) {
  return parts.some((part) => part?.metadata?.aidd === FOLLOW_UP.aidd);
}

/** Pure: the user's message -> every UserPromptSubmit hook's call, none for a follow-up. The text
 * is the user's own: a part another hook added is not. */
function userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory) {
  const parts = output?.parts ?? [];
  if (isFollowUp(parts)) return [];
  const prompt = parts
    .filter((part) => part?.type === "text" && !part.synthetic)
    .map((part) => part.text)
    .join("\n");
  return USER_PROMPT_SUBMIT.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: {
      hook_event_name: "UserPromptSubmit",
      session_id: input?.sessionID ?? null,
      cwd: directory,
      prompt,
    },
  }));
}

/** Each answer becomes a synthetic text part after the user's, its id derived from the first
 * part's, this plugin's name and the hook's place in its list, so no two parts share one. */
async function addPromptContext(input, output, directory) {
  const calls = userPromptCallsFor(input, output, directory);
  for (const [index, call] of calls.entries()) {
    const answer = await answerOf(call.script, call.args, call.payload, directory);
    if (!answer) continue;
    output.parts.push({
      id: output.parts[0].id + "-" + "aidd-telemetry" + "-" + index,
      messageID: output.message?.id,
      sessionID: input?.sessionID,
      type: "text",
      text: answer,
      synthetic: true,
    });
  }
}

function sessionStartCallsFor(event, directory) {
  if (event?.type !== "session.created") return [];
  return SESSION_START.map((hook) => ({
    script: hook.script,
    args: hook.args,
    payload: { hook_event_name: "SessionStart", session_id: event.properties?.sessionID ?? null, cwd: event.properties?.info?.directory ?? directory },
  }));
}

const AiddTelemetryKiloHooks = async ({ directory, client }) => {
  const sessions = new Map();
  return {
  event: async ({ event }) => {
    try {
      const properties = event?.properties;
      const id = properties?.sessionID;
      if (typeof id !== "string") return;
      if (event?.type === "session.deleted") { sessions.delete(id); return; }
      if (!sessions.has(id)) sessions.set(id, { started: false, idle: false, continued: false, directory });
      const session = sessions.get(id);
      let calls = [];
      if (event?.type === "session.created" && !session.started) {
        session.started = true;
        session.directory = properties?.info?.directory ?? directory;
        calls = sessionStartCallsFor(event, session.directory);
      } else if (event?.type === "session.status" && properties?.status?.type === "busy") {
        session.idle = false;
      } else if (event?.type === "session.idle" && !session.idle) {
        session.idle = true;
        // Limit: one Stop hook per plugin; with several, the last verdict decides the continuation.
        for (const hook of STOP) {
          const payload = { hook_event_name: "Stop", session_id: id, cwd: session.directory, stop_hook_active: session.continued };
          const reason = await stopReasonOf(hook.script, hook.args, payload, session.directory);
          session.continued = reason !== "";
          // Not awaited: the prompt is the session's next turn, and this handler must not hold it.
          // Kilo 7.8.27's `run` waits for the queue to drain, so the follow-up lands there too; awaiting
          // it from `dispose` fails with an UnknownError. 7.7.5 lost it in `run`.
          if (reason) {
            client.session
              .promptAsync({ path: { id }, body: { parts: [{ type: "text", text: reason, metadata: FOLLOW_UP }] } })
              .catch((error) => reportHookFailure(hook.script, "follow-up not delivered: " + String(error)));
          }
        }
      }
      for (const call of calls) {
        runHook(call.script, call.args, call.payload, call.payload.cwd);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  // A user's message starts a new turn. Kilo hands every plugin every message, so a follow-up,
  // this bridge's or another plugin's, is recognised by its mark and is not one.
  "chat.message": async (input, output) => {
    const session = sessions.get(input?.sessionID);
    if (session && !isFollowUp(output?.parts ?? [])) session.continued = false;
    try {
      await addPromptContext(input, output, session?.directory ?? directory);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  // The refusal is thrown out of the hook, the one way the host stops the call.
  "tool.execute.before": async (call, output) => {
    let refusal = null;
    try {
      refusal = await refusalOf(preToolUseCallsFor(call, output, sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
    if (refusal !== null) throw new Error(refusal);
  },
  "tool.execute.after": async (call, output) => {
    try {
      const tool = String(call?.tool ?? "");
      const cwd = sessions.get(call?.sessionID)?.directory ?? directory;
      // Kilo names the written file filePath; the scripts read Claude Code's file_path.
      const args = call?.args;
      const toolInput = typeof args?.filePath === "string" ? { ...args, file_path: args.filePath } : args;
      for (const hook of POST_TOOL_USE.filter((hook) => matchesTool(hook.matcher, tool))) {
        const answer = await answerOf(hook.script, hook.args, { hook_event_name: "PostToolUse", session_id: call?.sessionID ?? null, cwd, tool_name: tool, tool_input: toolInput }, cwd);
        if (answer) output.output = `${output.output ?? ""}\n\n${answer}`;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[aidd] Kilo hook dispatch failed: " + String(error));
    }
  },
  };
};

AiddTelemetryKiloHooks.sessionStartCallsFor = sessionStartCallsFor;

export default { id: "aidd-telemetry-hooks", server: AiddTelemetryKiloHooks };
